messages:
Mira Chen: Quick handoff note before I sign off — I'm handing overnight primary to Alejandro. Primary = Alejandro R, Secondary = James H, Shadow = Kat S. There is a known coverage gap between 02:00-03:00 UTC (we only have one person on call then). Please follow the 'lateral handoff' checklist below and call out if you need a warm backup.

Mira Chen: Quick checklist:
- Confirm pager routing: primary -> alejandro-pager, secondary -> james-pager.
- Confirm access: confirm you can access oncall playbooks and KMS logs (https://redwood-internal/runbooks/overnight-handoff).
- If you accept, send a :thumbsup: in this thread.

Alejandro R: Taking primary. I can cover 01:30-08:00 UTC. I'll shadow deployments during first hour.

James H: Acknowledged secondary. I won't be reachable 02:15-02:45 UTC (calendar block) — sets the stated coverage gap. If something spikes then, please escalate to Kat S or ops pager.

Kat S: I can shadow remotely from 02:00-04:00 UTC, will act as warm fallback. Add me to any bridges.

incident-bot: [AUTOMATED] New alert: latency-service/us-west p50 > 320ms for 3m on route /v1/generate. Severity: P1 if customer impact confirmed.

Alejandro R: Seeing the bot — pulling quick metrics. If p50 stays above 300ms and error rate raises >0.5% for 5m, page primary+secondary immediately.

Mira Chen: Adding runbook pointer: runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/latency-spike — TL;DR steps:
```
1) Confirm impact (synthetic vs customers)
2) Isolate model variant and region (use request logs)
3) Check autoscale/backfill & GPU queue depths
4) If not resolved in 10m, escalate to SRE lead and open a bridge
```

James H: For escalation rules (copying for clarity):
- Pager primary immediately for detection of high latency that affects >=5% traffic OR errors >=1% for 5m.
- If primary cannot mitigate in 10m, page SRE Lead (sre-lead pager) and Eng on-call for model runtime (eng-runtime pager).
- If customer-facing rollback required, call product-ops and legal depending on SLA.

Alejandro R: Practical steps I'm doing now:
- `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep us-west` -> checking pod restarts and OOMs
- `tail -n 200 /var/log/inference/serve.log | grep ERROR` -> quick errors scan
- Checking queue depth in /metrics -> GPU queue at 78% (normal threshold 85%).

ops-bot: DM reminder sent to Alejandro R: "You're primary until 08:00 UTC. If you miss an acknowledgment, secondary will be auto-switched after 10m."

Kat S: If we need to open a bridge: use `#inc-bridge` channel, subject format: "INC [region] [short-symptom]". Invite list: primary, secondary, SRE-lead, eng-runtime, product-ops.

Alejandro R: Not seeing errors in logs, latency looks spread across multiple model variants — could be upstream quota or cache churn. I'm enabling prefix caching for the small-routes experiment (will monitor).

Mira Chen: If you flip any routing or caching changes, please do a controlled canary: 10% traffic for 5m then verify metrics. Document the canary in the thread with the exact commands used.

Alejandro R: Canary started at 1719054600. Command: `redwood deploy --canary=10% --route=small-routes --reason="overnight mitigation"`

incident-bot: [AUTOMATED] Canary metric check at 1719054900: p50 reduced from 320ms to 260ms on canary subset. No new errors.

James H: Good sign. If this holds for 15m and overall p50 moves below 300ms, consider rolling the config to 50% then 100% with 5m observation windows.

Alejandro R: Rolling to 50% at 1719055060, monitoring.

Kat S: Noted — if rollback needed, use `redwood rollback --route=small-routes --to=prev-config` and page product-ops after rollback if customer-visible.

Alejandro R: Rolling finished at 1719055160. Overall p50 is 290ms now, error rate stable. Keeping an eye for 20m.

Mira Chen: Closing out the handoff notes:
- Accepted by Alejandro at 1719054328.
- Coverage gap 02:15-02:45 UTC noted — Kat will serve as warm fallback.
- Escalation path: primary -> secondary (10m) -> SRE Lead (15m) -> Eng-runtime (20m).
- Bridge protocol and runbook link shared.

Alejandro R: Thanks — I'll handle the whole night unless something changes. Ping me on pager or this thread if you need me to hand back. :lock: 

James H: Thanks team. I'll monitor silently; will jump on bridge if pages arrive.

incident-bot: [AUTOMATED] Alert resolved at 1719055200. Summary: canary mitigated latency, rolled to 50% -> full; no customer escalations.

Mira Chen: Great work — adding final notes to the runbook and closing thread. If any postmortem needed, we'll start a doc in `#postmortems`. :tada:

Alejandro R: :thumbsup:
